formulation: Binary x_i=1 when station i is selected. Primary objective: minimize sum_i x_i subject to x_u + x_v >= 1 for every normalized edge (u,v). QUBO form: minimize A * sum_i x_i + B * sum_{(u,v)} (1 - x_u)(1 - x_v), with B chosen strictly larger than the maximum possible cardinality difference so infeasible selections cannot beat feasible ones. The lexicographic tie-break among minimum-cardinality covers requires either superincreasing secondary weights w_i (w_i > sum_{j>i} w_j) added to x_i, or a hierarchical two-stage solve: first fix the minimum cardinality, then minimize the lexicographic rank. The exact penalty dominance, weight scaling and tie-break encoding must be validated.
finding: Positive superincreasing weights added to selected bits in minimization prefer the wrong selected-index tuple.
limit: Refutes this encoding branch only. The separate exact two-stage alternative is not refuted. No model-generated program, quantum circuit, or full migration was executed. Labels and scores unchanged.
